name: Pan-Fried Thai Red Curry Cod with Carrot, Avocado & Cashew Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place curry paste, oil, soy sauce, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, red
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp soy sauce
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Drizzle with half of the spice paste, then turn to coat the fish. (Reserve bowl with remaining spice paste for the salad.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add cod and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the remaining spice paste. Add honey and stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl, along with the carrots, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cod and salad between plates. Enjoy!
